title: Apple Reports Record Q4 Earnings, iPhone Sales Surge
content: Apple Inc reported record fourth-quarter earnings on Thursday, driven by stronger-than-expected iPhone sales and growth in its services business. The tech giant posted revenue of $119.6 billion, up 8% from the year-ago period, beating analyst expectations of $117.9 billion. iPhone revenue came in at $69.7 billion, a 6% increase year-over-year. CEO Tim Cook said the results reflect the strength of Apple's ecosystem and continued customer loyalty. The company's services segment, which includes the App Store, Apple Music, and iCloud, generated $23.1 billion in revenue, up 11% from last year. Apple also announced a $110 billion share buyback program, the largest in corporate history.
summary: Apple Inc reported record fourth-quarter earnings on Thursday, driven by stronger-than-expected iPhone sales and growth in its services business.
